tool_input.command: uv run --group dev pytest --junitxml=.factory/junit.xml 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "--- lint ---"; uv run --group dev python -m compileall -q src; echo "lint exit: $?"; echo "--- status ---"; git status --short
tool_input.description: Run pytest, lint, and show git status

structured_output.summary: Added `percent_change(old, new)` to `src/calc/core.py` as a pure function returning `(new - old) / old` with a docstring stating the result is a fraction (0.25 == +25 %), that negative results mean a fall, that negative `old` is accepted with the sign following the raw formula, and that `old == 0` raises `ValueError`; the zero check uses `==` so it catches `0`, `0.0` and `-0.0`. Exported the name from `src/calc/__init__.py` by extending the import line and adding it to `__all__` in alphabetical order. Appended eleven tests to `tests/test_core.py` covering rise, fall, no change, parametrized zero-old rejection, negative old, new == 0, float return type, `__all__` membership and the docstring; the existing three tests were left untouched. Tests were written first and confirmed red (ImportError on collection), then the implementation turned them green: `uv run --group dev pytest --junitxml=.factory/junit.xml` ends with `14 passed`, and `uv run --group dev python -m compileall -q src` exits 0. No changes to factory.toml or pyproject.toml, nothing committed.
